## Environment

Mod commit/version, Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge version, Java version, OS, GPU and additional mods.

## Reproduction

Exact steps from a fresh world, installed parts, server/client configuration and expected versus observed behavior.

## Evidence

Attach redacted latest.log/crash report and screenshots. State whether it reproduces on a dedicated server. Do not upload credentials or a private world without reviewing its contents.

## Scope check

Confirm the feature is listed as implemented, rather than a model study or roadmap item.
